cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Rank Everything
cards.instruction: Turn every new contribution into a ranking that places you nearer the top.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put my printer lesson first in the project report. Your restart can go underneath; I taught you that check.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The restart got all the invoices printed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Very good application. Second place. Teaching the method stays first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your hundred-page lunch menu was the blockage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then test-setting goes above teaching. I gave you a real fault to practise on. My lesson is second now; your restart is third.

reason: Make the specific pupil assessment, correction or influence claim shape the pursuit and the response to each partner contribution.
